summary: The shell has a system translation popover as a pure model, and the SDK has translation sessions over an engine the app supplies. Third-party translation apps cannot provide the selection popover, and there is no default-translation-app setting. iPadOS 18.4 and later per the index; nothing has run on a tablet.
rea_evidence: not captured: REA capture pending (tools/parity/rea-page.sh not run this round; owner rule); facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.feature: In-place translation popover for a selection
features.note: The shell's popover is a model of the state shown while a selection translates.

features.feature: Extension protocol for a translation app
features.note: No extension point lets another app supply the popover.
No scene type for a translation extension.
The session takes source and target language; the extension configuration object does not exist.

features.apple: Preparing your app to be the default translation app
features.note: No setting chooses a translation app.

gaps: Third-party apps cannot supply the selection popover (no extension point).
